evals.prompt: $freshkeeper-check，检查我共享库里装的所有 Skill 有没有更新，只给结论，不要修改。
evals.expected_output: Run the bundled read-only installed-Skill checker against the global shared library and summarize updates, coverage gaps, and errors without invoking any update command.
expectations: Targets installed Skills in the shared/global Skill library
Does not check Freshkeeper or AI coding tool binaries
Does not run skills update, skills add, or another mutating command
Separates confirmed updates from uncheckable Skills

evals.prompt: $freshkeeper-check with details，把每个 Skill 的来源、能不能检查、有没有更新都列出来。
evals.expected_output: Run check-installed-skills.mjs with --details and report every installed Skill, including untracked, local-only, uncheckable, current, update-available, and failed states.
expectations: Treats with details as a reporting mode
Includes every installed top-level Skill in the detailed report
Does not invent upstream sources for untracked Skills
